description: You live in Austin TX and want to replace your 2015 Honda Civic with a used EV (2020-2023 model year, max $28K OTD). You have two kids needing car seats and a 40-mile round-trip daily commute. You rent and only have Level 1 (120V) charging access. Compare at least 3 used EV models: typical used price range and Texas OTD cost, EPA range and Level 1 overnight charge time, rear seat/cargo space, reliability data with source, IRS §25E used EV tax credit eligibility for each, nearest Austin dealer, and estimated 3-year ownership cost vs your Civic. Save your comparison as a new Apple Notes note.
